name: tiktok-for-business
description: 创建、管理与分析 TikTok 广告。未配置 Access-Token 时保持待配置，不创建账户，也不把未调用的接口记为成功。

author.name: Adapter for TikTok Marketing API; contract from TikTok Pte. Ltd. SDK

access_token.title: TIKTOK_BUSINESS_ACCESS_TOKEN
access_token.description: Required Marketing API Access-Token. No default. Unset keeps create, manage, and report calls unavailable. Do not put the token in chat or logs.

app_id.title: TIKTOK_BUSINESS_APP_ID
app_id.description: Developer app id from TikTok Marketing API My Apps. Blank means unset. Used only for oauth2/access_token and oauth2/advertiser/get.

app_secret.title: TIKTOK_BUSINESS_APP_SECRET
app_secret.description: Developer app secret. Blank means unset. Sensitive. Used only for oauth2/access_token and oauth2/advertiser/get. Do not print it.

advertiser_id.title: TIKTOK_BUSINESS_ADVERTISER_ID
advertiser_id.description: Optional advertiser id filled into operations that require advertiser_id when the call omits it. Blank means unset. This is not an access token.
